chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Shu'ayb ibn Yaqoub, from Abu Baseer, who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the Mut'a of the women. He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is permissible, and it suffices in it the Dirham and what is above it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum dower required for temporary marriage (Mut'a)?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) via Abu Basir confirms the permissibility of Mut'a (temporary marriage) and establishes a minimal dower threshold of one Dirham, reflecting the flexibility of the contract's financial requirements. In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith is pivotal for validating the validity of Mut'a even with nominal consideration, distinguishing it from permanent marriage where higher dowers are customary but not strictly mandatory for validity.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Shuayb Bin Yaqoub, from Abu Baseer who said,
‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws about Mut’a of the women. Heasws said: ‘Permissible, and it suffices (as a dower) in it, the Dirham and what is above it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Shu’ayb ibn Ya’qub from abu Basir who has said the following: “
I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about al-Mut‘ah (advantageous marriage) of women. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is lawful and one dirham or more is enough (as mahr (dower)).”’
